current_point.claim: 提出了一种基于图摘要的分布式图神经网络优化训练算法DSGNN，采用“领导-工作者”模式，领导节点基于边分割的图流划分算法划分原图并分配子图给工作节点，工作节点执行基于图摘要的小批量训练，并通过注意力层返回训练结果给领导节点，领导节点汇总结果计算梯度并同步更新所有计算节点上的模型，从而加速大规模图流数据的GNN训练。
current_point.claim_en: Proposed a distributed graph neural network optimization training algorithm DSGNN based on graph summarization, which adopts a leader-worker mode. The leader divides the original graph using a graph flow partition algorithm based on edge segmentation, assigns subgraphs to workers; workers perform mini-batch training based on graph summarization, return training results to the leader through an attention layer; the leader aggregates results, computes gradients, and synchronously updates models on all computing nodes, thereby accelerating GNN training on large-scale graph streaming data.
technical_features: 采用“领导—工作者”工作模式
领导节点利用基于边分割的图流划分算法对原图进行划分
将划分的子图分配给各工作节点
工作节点执行基于图摘要的小批量训练
训练结果通过注意力层返回给领导节点
领导节点汇总结果并计算梯度，根据梯度同步更新所有计算节点上的模型
technical_features_en: The leader divides the original graph using a graph flow partition algorithm based on edge segmentation
Assign the divided subgraphs to each worker
Workers perform mini-batch training based on graph summarization technology
Training results are returned to the leader through an attention layer
The leader summarizes results, calculates gradients, and synchronously updates models on all computing nodes according to the gradient
